subject: how to array slice in STAN?

messages.author: 8fbb292485019894
messages.subject: how to array slice in STAN?
parts:
I was trying my hand at using the array slicing in STAN.  Following the manual, I'm trying to compile code that looks like:

model {
    int test[3];
    test[1] <- 0;
    test[2] <- 1;
    test[3] <- 2;
    test[1:2] <- test[2:3];
}

But, I get the following compile error:

22:        test[1:2] <- test[2:3];
                 ^
23:        //eta ~ normal(0, 1);

PARSER EXPECTED: "]"

I'm a tad bit confused on how to use this feature.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] how to array slice in STAN?

What version of Stan are you using? With CmdStan v2.10, that worked fine.
